description: Gracefully control the waves to rep for House RuneHawk!

name: RuneHawk Surfboard (Non-AC)
description: Gracefully control the waves to rep for House RuneHawk!

name: Runic Poleaxe of Kheimon (0 AC)
description: Deep in the frozen mountains of the Northlands live a sect of Monks who derive all their power from the ice around them.

description: Deep in the frozen mountains of the Northlands live a sect of Monks who derive all their power from the ice around them.

name: Runic Poleaxe of Kheimon (Merge)
description: (Requires Monster Drop Versions of items) Deep in the frozen mountains of the Northlands live a sect of Monks who derive all their power from the ice around them.

name: Runic Silence
description: A mere whisper, traveling on the soft cool breeze of a summer night, is louder than this stealthy staff. Yet, silence is often more deadly than the loudest explosion.

name: Rusted Blood Orb Staff
description: Annihilate your enemies as a Blood Sorcerer, and make them tremble at the power of your terrifying blood magic!

name: S.S. Phantom Cane (0 AC)
description: An elegant cane that belonged to a legendary pirate. It always finds its way to the captain possessed by their ghost.

name: S.S. Phantom Cane (AC)
description: An elegant cane that belonged to a legendary pirate. It always finds its way to the captain possessed by their ghost.

name: Sakura Fan Staff
description: Do not let the beauty of this staff fool you… the petals are made of carved, tinted ivory and can crush the skull of any who mock you!

name: Samba Surfboard
description: Troll's up!

name: Sanctolina Staff
description: A brilliant staff of hope and healing. The magic it holds can't heal physical injuries, but it miraculously mends broken spirits. Sometimes, the deadliest wounds are invisible.

name: Sand Golem Staff
description: Formed from the essence of your dreams, the Sand Golem has come to life to inhabit your waking world.

name: Sand Storm Staff
description: The Sand Storm is a suffocating wall of disaster that will smother and ruin everything in its path. It is unfeeling, uncaring and unbiased when it sweeps across through the land. When a mad transient created this staff, it was with all of that in mind. He was a drifter, but not by choice and this staff was his retribution.

name: SandSea Guardian's Staff
description: The Sandsea Guardian is a member of the elite Oasis Defense Force. Their armor helms helps them blend in with the dunes, making attacking their enemies much easier.

name: Sandsea HarpySlayer's Staff
description: A special unit of assassins answering only to the Sandsea Generals, these HarpySlayer's are sent after only the most difficult of foes.

name: Sapphire Cobra Cane
description: Canes like these were entrusted to the captains of each unit of the Sphinx Sentinels. They can sense and turn towards those with Evil intent. When Sek-Duat first set foot in the Sandsea, the cobras stared at him with venom.

name: Sapphire Mana Surge
description: Harness the power of pure, sapphire-colored mana. Wield it wisely, wizard, or you will bring entire towns down around your feet!

name: Sapphire Spiked Staff
description: Fashioned from beautiful sapphires this staff is beneficial for mental clarity.

name: Savior of Light
description: Behold the power of Light that brings you out of the darkness. You took this from the Willowcreek War Chest after battling for Chaos in World War Lore!

name: Savior of Shadows
description: Behold the power of Shadows that cast you into the darkness. You took this from the Willowcreek War Chest after battling for Chaos in World War Lore!

name: Scarab Staff
description: Scarabs were used as magical foci in the older Sandsea years. The bugs naturally absorb the magic in the area and store it in their bodies. This Scarab was particularly juicy when he was put on this staff.

name: Scarlet Flame Sorcerer's Scythe
description: A curved and cruel scythe that also acts as a staff. The blue light dangles and chimes in the darkness, like the lantern of an angler waiting for dull-minded prey.

name: Scarletta Surfboard 2016
description: Surfs up for Scarletta!

name: Scavenged Infernal Staff
description: So you lost your weapon - well, don't despair! Grab bits of any Infernal items lying around and get your Blacksmith to craft a whole new weapon! Don't forget to attach the Swordhaven symbol and toss on some horns that you nabbed when you battled one of the Infernal Army, and voila! New weapon!

name: Scepter Mace
description: Passed down from generations, this scepter's secrets are only relieved once the new holder endures a most difficult challenge.

name: Scepter of Ithil
description: This staff, wielded long ago by Elven Priests, boosts your white magic.

name: Scepter Of Orloc
description: Passed down from generations, this scepter's secrets are only relieved once the new holder endures a most difficult challenge.

name: Scepter of Suffering Immemorial
description: A staff that harnesses the power of deep hatred and spite, frozen in a moment of great suffering. The Fiends who were used to create this weapon will never be remembered. To all, including their Master, they were just ingredients.

name: Scepter of the Divine
description: It's divine, daaarling.

name: Scepter of the Ignited Ones
description: The flame that burns on top of this staff represents the light that guides the way for the Order of the Ignited Ones. These have been specially commissioned for their Summer celebration.

name: Sceptre of Divination
description: Beware the gypsy powers infused in this staff, for they're guaranteed to blow your mind (anytime!).

name: Scorching Orb Staff
description: Be careful when touching it. Physical contact will instantly fill one's mind with laughter, screams, and laments of the souls trapped inside. When emotions are retained, it is more than enough to break down and shatter a pure soul until the staff is let go.

name: Scream-o-mancer's Staff
description: There are certain times of year when the need to SCREAM (and make others do it too) is totally ok!

name: Scythe of Nibiru
description: A weapon unlike any other, this weapon thrives off the untouched mana of its wielder. It is comprised of unidentified matter not from this world.

name: Scythe of Slough
description: Rather than being forged from Mudluk hands, this scythe evolved from the organic matter found in the swamp. It is very much alive as it is deadly.

name: Sea Fury Staff
description: Call the upon the of the sea to guide you against evil.

name: Sea Fury Staff +25
description: Call the upon the of the sea to guide you against evil. Gives +25% damage to undead when equipped!

name: Seed Stalker Scroll
description: You obtained more information about the Seed Stalkers. Loremaster Anka in the Chaos Librarium will gather all the information into a scroll for you.

name: Seedspitter Lore Scroll
description: This scroll dropped off a Seedspitter. Take it to Loremaster Maya in the Librarium and she'll tell you more about the monster.

name: Sekt Surfboard 2016
description: Surfs up for Sekt!

name: Sepulchure Surfboard
description: Surf your way through the summer with this epic surfboard designed by Catpyre.

name: Sepulchure Surfboard 2015
description: Surfs up for Seppy!

name: Seraph Calamity
description: This devine staff will give you the holy power needed to strike down your foes.

name: Serene Moon Staff (0 AC)
description: The night belongs to darkness, but so does the moon. We yearn for what we can not have and what we can not be. The bow conjures mystical dreams. Ones that could become true and yours.

name: Serene Moon Staff (AC)
description: The night belongs to darkness, but so does the moon. We yearn for what we can not have and what we can not be. The bow conjures mystical dreams. Ones that could become true and yours.

name: Serenity's Frostval Candy Cane
description: Don't hit them too hard, you don't want to waste Serenity's sweet treat. She spent all night making candy in Yulgar's kitchen.

name: Shadow Aristocrat Cane (AC)
description: The handle is also a hand warmer. Keep an eye on it. The little guy might sneak a few bites from your meals.

name: Shadow Aristocrat Cane (Legend)
description: The handle is also a hand warmer. Keep an eye on it. The little guy might sneak a few bites from your meals.

name: Shadow Dragon Surfboard

name: Shadow Eye of the Underworld
description: Things not to ask Dage about this staff, 1) what's that eye looking at? 2) who's eye is it, 3) is that mist deadly… because it's probably deadly.

name: Shadow Orb Staff
description: Control the shadows as a Shadow Sorcerer, and make your enemies weep… with fear of you AND the darkness!

name: Shadow Priest Staff
description: Be consumed by the Shadows, and see the truth that the light has cast away.

name: Shadow Pumpkin Witch's Broom (0 AC)
description: The broom leaves a dark trail of stars as it zips across the sky.

name: Shadow Pumpkin Witch's Broom (AC)
description: The broom leaves a dark trail of stars as it zips across the sky.

name: Shadow Pumpkin Witch's Staff (0 AC)
description: A staff that casts spells of festive Mogloween cheer! Liven the night for trick-or-treaters, or send the town a message by turning them into next year's pumpkin crop.

name: Shadow Pumpkin Witch's Staff (AC)
description: A staff that casts spells of festive Mogloween cheer! Liven the night for trick-or-treaters, or send the town a message by turning them into next year's pumpkin crop.

name: Shadow's Fang Staff
description: Looks like you need some backbone to use this spiny staff.

name: Shadow Zorbak Staff
description: Much mischief can be made whenever Zorbak is active, but when doom manifests in his form, his staff can distort his pranks for the very worst.

name: Shadowed War-Mage Staff
description: Often hiding in the shadows, these seasoned war mages use the dark to heightened their power in battle.

name: Shadowfall Gravelyn Surfboard (0 AC)
description: ﻿Claim the waves in the name of Empress Gravelyn's Empire.

name: Shadowfall Gravelyn Surfboard (AC)
description: ﻿Claim the waves in the name of Empress Gravelyn's Empire.

name: ShadowFire Staff (AC)
description: The ice shard that powers this staff is from the coldest parts of Glacera.

name: ShadowFire Staff (Legend)
description: The ice shard that powers this staff is from the coldest parts of Glacera.

name: ShadowFlame Battle Staff
description: Those who study the magics of the ShadowFlame slowly begin to become one with them.

name: ShadowFlame Defender's Scythe
description: Good, Evil, or Chaos… the heroes of Lore have always followed leader whose nature is well-defined, and whose goals are clear. But for those who choose to serve Malgor, the leader of the ShadowFlame… a very dark fate awaits.

name: ShadowFlame DragonMage Staff
description: Something wicked is definitely on its way when Shadowflame DragonMage's meet to summon powerful dragons.

name: ShadowFlame Eviscerator Staff
description: The weapon gives a peek into the unforgiving cosmos. One day, the stars may become eyes that will scorn your power and prestiege.

name: Shadowmage Staff
description: Overflowing with such power that it crackles up and down the shaft. These staves while deadly, are incredibly unstable. They are best discarded after the target is neutralized.

name: Shadowscythe Emblem Surboard (0 AC)
description: The Shadowscythe's glare will successfully scare away curious sharks. So stick your legs out like a seal, if your malicious magnificence pleases.

name: Shadowscythe Emblem Surboard (AC)
description: The Shadowscythe's glare will successfully scare away curious sharks. So stick your legs out like a seal, if your malicious magnificence pleases.

name: ShadowScythe Staff
description: Getting energy from every spell, this staff helps power the Shadowscythe.

name: ShadowScythe Wand
description: Mages of Lore who have turned to Evil have become the Shadowscythe Troopers. These are the first into battle, and will take devastating losses just to get the job done. For the ShadowScythe!

name: ShadowSnow Staff
description: I've heard of a rain stick but on that can make snow?!?! Snowball fight in July!!!

name: ShadowStalker of Time Staff
description: This special clock-like specter a delicate device its user must take care of because of its dangerous ability to predict a specific future that can rarely be changed by fate.

name: ShadowWalker of Time Staff
description: This special clock-like specter a delicate device its user must take care of because of its dangerous ability to predict a specific future that can rarely be changed by fate.

name: ShadowWeaver of Time Staff
description: These intrepid, timely explorers can step into a shadow in one time-stream and emerge from a completely different shadow in another time stream.

name: Shadowy Staff of Ruin (0 AC)
description: On a dark night, in a dark ritual, a ring of Shadow Druids called this weapon from the plane of, guess what… marshmallows. No wait…DARKNESS! (CC to accessory)

name: Shadowy Staff of Ruin (AC)
description: On a dark night, in a dark ritual, a ring of Shadow Druids called this weapon from the plane of, guess what… marshmallows. No wait…DARKNESS! (CC to accessory)

name: Sharkskin Stabber
description: OW OW OW! Do NOT touch the point of this staff. Or anywhere on it, really. The dermal denticles that make up shark skin HURT. (Daily Login Gift for Saturday, July 15th.)

name: Shattered Legion War Staff
description: You found this war staff locked inside the Seven Circles war chest. Dage the Evil must be pleased with your performance.

name: Shattered Screams Staff
description: The Nightmare Child has gifted you with this staff as a reminder of all the fun you've shared with her! She hopes when you see it, your screams will be of laughter, unlike those of the souls trapped in the weapon.

name: Sheathed Diabolical Sword
description: Travelling the dark seas requires you to not only take charge of your crew but to prove your worth. Only the most dedicated of the Diabolical fleet are granted the title of Admiral — wear it with pride.

name: Shifting Scroll
description: You recovered the Shifting Scroll in your quest to complete the Arachna Codex! This copy was made for you to commemorate that accomplishment.

name: Shimmering Scroll
description: You recovered the Shimmering Scroll in your quest to complete the Arachna Codex! This copy was made for you to commemorate that accomplishment.

name: Shocking Pink Caster Staff
description: This staff holds powerful magic of Pink Star light!

name: Sienna Fall Cane (AC)
description: The Autumn Undertaker's cane it's own entity. To those who willingly fall asleep beneath the leaves, it is nothing but polite. When approached by those who want to bargain, all it can do is laugh.

description: The Autumn Undertaker's cane it's own entity. To those who willingly fall asleep beneath the leaves, it is nothing but polite. When approached by those who want to bargain, all it can do is laugh.

description: On nights overflowing with mysticism, the moon takes the shape of this staff's crux. Capturing that power can allow you to make your foes disappear with the end of the night.

name: Silver Crescent Staff (AC)
description: On nights overflowing with mysticism, the moon takes the shape of this staff's crux. Capturing that power can allow you to make your foes disappear with the end of the night.

name: Silver Cyborg Monk Staff
description: A staff that acts as a weapon and a tool of meditation. The rings chime as the monk chants lines of code.

name: Silver Cyborg Monk Stick
description: Definitely not used for walking, and the Cyborg Monk has long since moved passed the virtue of humility.

name: Silver Dragonpriest's Staff
description: Drawing energy from the land powers this staff.

name: Sinister Staff of Mana Leech
description: It's said that this living staff devours all mana and magic it comes near.

name: Skeleton Lore Scroll
description: This scroll dropped off a Skeleton. Take it to Loremaster Maya in the Librarium and she'll tell you more about the monster.

name: Skull Cane
description: The proper cane for those who are thick-headed. Super effective against young hooligans.

name: Skull-Staff of Torment
description: 300 years ago, a conclave of Most High Necromancers elected Kaz'ahar their Supreme Leader. This is the staff he wielded, sending gouts of flame coursing through his enemies.

name: Skull With Stick
description: Whoever this poor NPC used to be… they'll never give out a quest again. :(

name: SkullSeeker Cane
description: Only the finest Undead Legion warriors have been granted the permission to use the SkullSeeker Cane.

name: SkyGuard Cane
description: The nefarious SkyPirate General must have stripped this off of a fallen SkyGuard Captain. Keep it so that it is no longer defiled by Pirate hands!

name: Skyguard Commander's Cane (AC)
description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch aerial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

description: Yarrr! Ye be the captain of a Skyship, and yer main goal is to launch aerial attacks against th' forces of Chaos. For King, for crown, for SWORDHAVEN!

description: Ewwww…. looks like the slime is trying to digest this staff.

name: Snarling Jester Staff
description: What's wrong? Can't take a joke?

name: Sneevil Lore Scroll
description: This scroll dropped off a Sneevil. Take it to Loremaster Maya in the Librarium and she'll tell you more about the monster.

name: Snow Leopard Skinwalker's Staff
description: Mainly used in various rituals, but also good in a pinch for whacking things over the head.

name: Snowglobe of Nulgath
description: Not exactly sure how the Archfiend ended up in a snow globe and probably better off not finding out.

name: Sol Proxima
description: There will come a day when the sun sets for the very last time. Emissary Astero knows it to be so, and we must prepare. When the end comes, the Light will embrace all.

name: Solar Fabricator Staff
description: This staff was created by drawing upon the white-hot flames that burn at the heart of the Plane of Fire itself.

name: Solar Portent Staff
description: This weekend's solar eclipse opened a portal from the realm of Darkness into Lore… let's hope the solar eclipse in OUR world doesn't do the same! O_O

name: Solar Star Staff
description: As agile and deadly as this staff in heat is crafted to be, don't touch the handle without wearing metal gloves or else you'll end up like Artix.

name: Solrac's Staff
description: A heavily modified magitech staff. This appears to be custom made for an unknown set of specifications.

name: Solstice Pulse Staff (0 AC)
description: When you cast spells with this staff, the golden orb burns bright. Your enemies will mistake it for the Sun coming to take their lives.

name: Solstice Pulse Staff (AC)
description: When you cast spells with this staff, the golden orb burns bright. Your enemies will mistake it for the Sun coming to take their lives.

name: Sora Surfboard 2016
description: Surfs up for Sora!

name: Soul Stealer Staff
description: Hey, this lantern is the perfect weapon to use when reaping the souls of the innocent… or guilty ones. Whatever's more convenient.

name: SoulSeeker Spear
description: Say it five times fast!

name: SoulSkewer of Nulgath
description: Some staves channel mana from the wielder by tapping into their inner reservoirs of tranquility. This staff saps from your rage instead.

name: Space-timeless Staff
description: Time is cyclical… who knows from where (or when?) the Chronocide got these weapons. Doesn't matter - it's yours now!

name: Sparkler (Staff)
description: Who says you can't play with fire? Because of magical enhancements, this sparkler will never go out!

name: Spear of Hail
description: Give your foes the cold shoulder with this spear at hand.

name: Spellbound Staff of Nulgath
description: Nulgath says, this staff can bend the will of your foes to obey your every command… or was it bend the will of the stave's owner? Bah, it doesn't matter.

name: SpellCaster's Bright Staff
description: Casters aide the Legion by summoning power and keeping the minions energized during battles.

name: SpellCaster's Dark Staff
description: Casters aide the Legion by summoning power and keeping the minions energized during battles.

name: Spiderkin Star Staff
description: This specially crafted Star Staff were designed and built for AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Spiderwing Scroll
description: You obtained more information about the Spiderwings. Loremaster Anka in the Chaos Librarium will gather all the information into a scroll for you.

name: Spinal Carnage Staff
description: Infused with the souls of previous combatants this sword is only for those who've survived the Death Pit Arena.

name: Spine Gripper
description: The undead staff of necromancy.

name: Spinning Battlemage Staff +5
description: The runes on the staff go round and round, round and round… and give you 5% more damage against Chaos monsters!

name: Spirit of Ice Staff
description: The spirit of ice gives thes beings their power. Their evertasting chill will freeze their enemies to the core.

name: Spiritual Manipulation Staff (0 AC)
description: This staff is veiled in a moaning mist. You need not draw from your own mana. Powerful seplls can be cast by using the lost souls tethered to the staff as fuel.

name: Spiritual Manipulation Staff (AC)
description: This staff is veiled in a moaning mist. You need not draw from your own mana. Powerful seplls can be cast by using the lost souls tethered to the staff as fuel.

name: Sprinkly Butter Stick of Yoshino
description: Celebrate Yoshino's Birthday with one of their favorite products known to lore, Butter!

name: Sprite's Twig
description: Cool! Little sprites are flying around this staff! It MUST be special.

name: Squepter
description: The golden staff of Lothalification!

name: Staff of Awe (0 AC)
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Staff of Awe! (AC)
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Staff of Baltocteniza
description: Contained in this staff are the accumulated curses of spiders that were eradicated from Lore. Their spite will live through your malicious magic.

name: Staff Of Blessings
description: Cleansing the world of evil never looked so beautiful.

name: Staff of Burning Embers
description: This staff was magically shaped from molten lava. The glow of its fiery heart is hypnotic and will entrance any who attempt to take it from you.

name: Staff of Casting
description: While casting spells doesn't always require a staff, it can amplify a casters power significantly. Much in the same way a fighter can fight with his bare hands but can deal much more damage with a sword.

name: Staff Of Conflagration
description: Twisted from evil, this staff may have once wielded good. But that was along ago.

name: Staff of Constellations
description: May the stars guide you ever onwards as you battle towards your destiny.

name: Staff of Darkness
description: Darkness… is… coming!

name: Staff of Dreamers
description: Music follows you through your dreams and the walking world. The inspiration is never ending.

name: Staff Of Eggzelence
description: The magic of the Egg, swirling, pulsing… If it doesn't mesmerize and hypnotize your enemy first, your attack will render them helpless.

name: Staff of Emeralds
description: With a blade made of emeralds, this katana slices through almost everything. But not diamond, because that's stronger.

name: Staff of Everlore
description: One day, the sun will shine everlasting. This sacred dream won't come true on it's own. Cleave the Darkness, destroy all Evil, let the Light into your heart, and allow it to save Lore.

name: Staff Of Feelings
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: A staff that slowly imbues its surroundings with joy and warmth is a handy weapon. The beating heart at the top is both a warning and a greeting from Disturbed Indestructible.

name: Staff of Glacial Destruction
description: To rise against injustice, you must be willing to make the hard decisions… no matter how chilling they might be.

name: Staff of Hail
description: "And the skies opened, covering the land in an icy rock formation…"

name: Staff of Imp Fire
description: You found a staff with an imp's head sculpted at the shaft. Its fire warms your hand.

name: Staff of Inversion (Staff)
description: You now posses the living staff of the very first Lord of Chaos! Lets hope you can control its power.

name: Staff of Isthmia
description: A magical staff that will lead the souls of the sea to a paradise of pearls and plenty. They move like schools of shimmering fish. Will they reach the afterlife, or will they swim into the maw of another beast?

name: Staff of Justice (1)
description: Tho' Justice is blind.. you are not. Use your power (and your staff) wisely.

name: Staff of Justice (2)
description: Those whose beliefs are not lawful and honest will serve the penalty… of death!

name: Staff of Malachite
description: He wants you, too… oh. Malachite. Never mind.

name: Staff of Mayhem
description: Mayhem is everywhere. Insure it spreads using this.

name: Staff Of Miracles
description: Life being able to persist despite the numerous forces that threaten its existence is a miracle in of itself. With this staff, draw power from the very lifeblood of your world.

name: Staff of Miturga
description: A staff created by an Arachnomancer who intended it to be a gift to their Necromancy mentor. The pair taught each other new and novel ways to rain terror on the unsuspecting world.

name: Staff of New Growth
description: Given only to the most gifted healers, this staff channels the power of crystals while preserving the delicate balance between the elements.

name: Staff of Omniramis
description: Defend the Elementals and fight those who wish to steal their powers!

name: Staff of Pestilence
description: The user of this staff can unleash a horrible plague upon their enemies.

name: Staff of Platinum Joy
description: This bright staff was created in the Celestial Realm, imued with magic by a peerless weaponsmith mage, and will cut blast the darkness and your enemies with equal ease.

name: Staff of Plenty
description: Just as the name suggests, this staff provides you with daily nutrition while inflicting massive amounts of Vitamin D!

name: Staff Of Reflections
description: Hold up this extraordinary tall hand mirror to the sun to absorb some much-needed powerful light magic. Only then will it unleash a beaming blast that could stun a large group of enemies in a single area.

name: Staff of Ruin
description: On a dark night, in a dark ritual, a ring of Dark Druids called this weapon from the plane of, guess what… marshmallows. No wait…DARKNESS!

name: Staff of Sapphires
description: With a blade made of sapphires, this katana slices through almost everything. But not diamond, because that's stronger.

name: Staff of Semiramis
description: Defend the Elementals and fight those who wish to steal their powers!

name: Staff Of Shadows
description: Such a behemoth of a staff is capable of trembling walls down to rubble in one swift slash.

name: Staff of Shattering
description: You have mastered your craft, so this pulsates revealing your power.

name: Staff of Soul-Stealing
description: Dance for the glory of Nulgath the Archfiend!

name: Staff of Soul Weaving
description: Arachnids have sought an ancient spider staff that holds the secrets of the Arachnomancer's past. Quibble is pretty sure this is the staff they're looking for.

name: Staff Of Spades
description: Spades are thought to be the most dominant suit of all, so using the Staff Of Spades in battle will bring you endless victories. Thank you for helping Artix Entertaiment recruit 1.3 Million new heroes!

name: Staff of Strangled Light
description: A soft glow suffocates in the grip of these petrified roots. Raised to the sky, it calls the Light to its center, plunging the day into complete darkness.

name: Staff of Thanks
description: Show your opponents what a simple "thanks" can do!

name: Staff of the Archfiend
description: Crafted by fiendish weaponsmiths chained to infernal forges, this staff was crafted in honor of Nulgath the ArchFiend. Only the strongest members of his Nation are worthy of wielding it.

name: Staff of the Burning Abyss
description: Some say this staff was used to summon Fiends, Imps and other terrifying creatures of the underworld. Whether they would obey you or devour you wasn't clear…

name: Staff of the Dark Moon
description: *No description*

name: Staff of the Depths
description: From out of the depths, a terror rises: a ghostly hand grasps this staff aimed directly at your heart. Do not fear… it is a gift from Neso, the Water Avatar, to aid you in battle.

name: Staff of the Dragon Conqueror
description: A true Dragon Conqueror must master both magic and brute fighting skills. This staff can help you with half the journey.

name: Staff of the Eve
description: Make sure to carry this staff with you at all times for when a goul or creature, that is not of this world, approaches, the top of the staff will shine brightly to light a path to safety.

name: Staff of the Fallen (1)
description: This Staff is said to hold the souls of fallen knights.

name: Staff of the Fallen (2)
description: A forgotten weapon devoid of all light, the only way to control the shadow raging to break free is to think of your strongest happy memory. Your very joy and willpower contains the staff's shadow.

name: Staff of the Northstar
description: An ice monarch can see the entire universe through one glance into the window encased in their scepters of power. Look through it to see the limitless universe for yourself. Gives 25% more XP.

name: Staff of the Rising Sun
description: Inspired by her recent trip to Tercessuinotlim, Irene put together this staff with the help of a lonesome falcon she spotted along the way. The orb in the middle contains a portal that takes its user to the safest place on their minds if they realized their predictaments have become inescapable.

name: Staff of the Sacrificial Lamb

name: The Divine Staff of Ra

name: The Galaxcythe
description: The creation of this scythe has baffled the magi of Arcangrove since its discovery a thousand years ago. The meaning of mana and xp is believed to reside within the weapon itself.

name: The Garden's Sphere
description: The staff allows you a peek at what paradise could be. Not what it actually is. The magic comes from trying to get close to this ideal as possible, and accepting that there will always be flaws.

name: The Gardens Sphere
description: If you peer closely into the globe, you can see a tiny paladin frolicking through the garden, slaying an army of very tiny skeletons.

name: The Lost Knight's Staff
description: This lost knight was one a brave warrior, but could not survive the horrors of… THE SPLATTER REALM! *Cue horror movie sound FX*

name: The Scepter of the Dead
description: Though little is known about this ancient staff. Rumor is that the scepter can resurrect the dead and control their every movement.

name: The Scythe of Lost Hope
description: The A precursor to the The Scythe of Emptiness, this scythe is said to have drained its victims of both body and mind.

name: The Super Pole
description: Can catch three fish at a time…

name: The Supreme Arcane Staff
description: After all the work you went through to put this thing together, it'd be a shame to leave it behind now! Take it with you as a trophy, so all see you as the savior of Arcangrove!

name: The Waiting Hour

name: Tidal Power Staff
description: Given only to the most gifted healers, this staff protects against the driving rain while preserving the delicate balance between the elements.

name: Tideweaver's Staff
description: A staff crowned with seafoam light, channeling the Queen's command over tides, storms, and the hidden spirits of the deep.

name: Time Keepers Presence

name: Troll's Last Stand

name: True Blue Love Cane

name: Twisted Staff of Inversion

name: Twisted Underworld Yew Staff (0 AC)

description: As the sacred creature of the Sek Duat Dynasty, the cobra represents the sun, the Sandsea, the king, and a number of ancient deities. The intricate carving on this staff is incredibly life-like…

description: Crystals and gems make a great magical focus. Adding an already magically enchanted skull on top makes it even more so.

name: Undead Walking Stick
description: This staff helps the dead walk again… and also those plagued with arthritis.

name: Vaden Surfboard 2016
description: Surf's up forVaden!

name: Vampire Lore Scroll
description: The ancient scroll's text can barely be read, but if you squint you can make out: "Only when the Blood Moon rises and the world's luck flees can spirits of the long-undead walk our world once more."

name: Vampire Queen Safiria Surfboard
description: A prize for the Vampires! Defeat the Lycans!

name: Vampire Queen Solani Surfboard
description: A prize for the Vampires! Defeat the Lycans!

name: Vampiric Knight's Cane

name: Vampiric Knight SUPER Cane
description: Claiming dominance is what average vampires consider to be a high honor anc the wielder of this elegant but batty sword that sent victims packing for centuries is rarely denied such a right.

name: Vengeful Azure Blossom Staff
description: Once blessed by the Avatar of Ice's power, it now radiates with Fimbul's magic. In a twist of dark fate, the staff resonates with Lore's leylines far deeper than it could with Kyanos' influence.

name: Victor's Advocatus Staff
description: A staff imbued with the power of the Fiend's Void. It was donated to the coliseum to entice the strong to reach even greater heights.

name: Vindicator Priest Staff

name: Violet GlowStick

name: Violet Sphere

name: Virgil of the Legion's Staff
description: Virgil, a servant of the former Death, guides souls the dark hopeless prison they find themselves in.

name: Virgo Changeling's Staff

name: Virtual Criminal Cyber Wand
description: *No description*

name: Vitae's Breath
description: Stand proud, Hero, and hold before you the breath of Vitae. Know that when you summon the power that is infused with into this staff, your own magic will be much more effective. Bring your enemies to their knees.

name: Void ArchMage of Nulgath Staff
description: The claw protects the ''eye'' of this powerful staff.

name: Void Avenger Scythe
description: This Bloodfiend's scythe was imbued with Void aura and used to great effect during the Underworld war against the Legion.

name: Void BattleMage Nation Staff
description: In the depths of battle against their foes, these elite BattleMage's use dark magic to defeat their many enemies.

name: Void Cryomancer Staff

name: Void GateKeeper's Staff (AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void GateKeeper's Staff (Non-AC)

name: Void Manipulation Staff

name: Void Medulla Makila

name: Void Orb Staff
description: Call upon the void in the name of the Archfiend

name: Void Reincarnation Staff

name: Void's Lace Runestaff
description: The usage of this rare glyph can summon sixteen tendrils composed of void magic straight from the realm it came from, striking and chilling your foes directly to the heart.

name: Void's Staff of Deception (0 AC)
description: The end of every Archfiend always comes from behind. At some point or another, they'll forget to look over their shoulder.

name: Void's Staff of Deception (AC)
description: The end of every Archfiend always comes from behind. At some point or another, they'll forget to look over their shoulder.

name: Void Sorcerer's Staff
description: The sorcerers of Nulgath's army channel a darker power than most mages will ever wield. They dedicate their lives and power to the glory of the ArchFiend!

name: Void Soulslayer Scythe
description: Enchanted with void essence through the flesh of Void Dragon,this scythe is used to corrupt and destroy the soul of your enemies.

name: Void Vessel
description: You can see a dark nothingness pulsing at the tip of this staff.

name: Void Warlock Staff
description: Powerful fiend's of magic, nothing will stop these Warlock's from helping their Archfiend conquer his foes.

name: Void Witch's Orb Staff
description: Even in the void witches find time to practice their craft.

name: Voidborn Warlock Staff
description: Voidborn Warlocks draw their power from the dark energies that saturate the place between worlds and times. They can traverse universes in the blink of an eye.

name: Voidsplinter Tether
description: Bearing crystallized bits of the void itself (the same material the Heart of the Void is made of), this weapon courses with dark energy!

name: Volleyball Hero's Rod
description: Life's a beach, no matter which position you play on your team! Bump… Set… SPIKE!

name: Volleyball Hero's Surfboard
description: Life's a beach, no matter which position you play on your team! Bump… Set… SPIKE!

name: Walis Tambo
description: Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan sa lahat ng mga bayaning Filipino! (Happy Independence Day to all our Filipino heroes!)

name: Walis Ting-ting
description: Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan sa lahat ng mga bayaning Filipino! (Happy Independence Day to all our Filipino heroes!)

name: Warforged Strife
description: War has a tendency to play rough with its kin, be it in this river of time or another. Even the distant pestilence would pray for their defeat. Perhaps by raising their weapons, you'll tame the beast.

name: Warlic's 16 Bit Staff
description: Perfect for channeling the elements of 16-bit fire, 16-bit water, and so on.

name: Warlic's Scorched Staff
description: The mightiest wand in all of Lore, reduced to brittle charcoal. It took long, excruciating eons to temper flames meant solely to destroy the stray and the Dragon of Time.

name: Warlic Surfboard 2016
description: Surfs up for Warlic!

name: Warlock of Love Heart Staff
description: In all this world, you might be happy, genuinely happy. Not one couple in a century has that chance, not really, but you could have it.

name: Warlock of Love Rose Staff
description: In all this world, you might be happy, genuinely happy. Not one couple in a century has that chance, not really, but you could have it.

name: WarpForce Surfboard (AC)
description: Show some love for Warpforce with this sleek surfboard!

name: WarpForce Surfboard (Non-AC)
description: Show some love for Warpforce with this sleek surfboard!

name: Water Elemental Staff
description: An understated staff that hides quite the history. Many artifacts like it were given to humankind by Elementals to teach them how to connect to the Planes.

name: Water Key Staff
description: Forged from a key, this staff harnesses the power of the water to subdue your opponent.

name: Water Weaver Staff
description: A weapon crafted by a special sect of weavers. They received some sort of gift from Hyonix to make this staff. She tore it out of herself, no longer needing such a thing…or deserving it.

name: Watermelon Surfboard
description: The red might trick sharks into tearing a bite out of your board. Actually, that might actually look kind of cool.

name: Watery Dragonpriest Staff
description: Drawing energy from the water power this staff.

name: Wave of Insanity
description: Use the power of the seas to cast a pall over your enemies, blinding them with the insanity of the depths. Force them to be lost between within the blues and greens that symbolize the ocean, forgetting which was is up and slowly drowning in their own minds.

name: Weaver Mage Orb Staff
description: Pulled from a fallen ChaosWeaver Mage, this staff has absorb all its magic and is now ready to unleash it.

name: Weaver Scepter
description: Command attention from your subjects. Remind them who they serve and why.

name: Whirling Snowflake Staff
description: Get ready to show your enemies a cold shoulder.

name: White Horsehead Cane (AC)
description: What's a dapper gentleman to do when he's feeling provoked? Whack 'em with his snazzy cane!

name: White Horsehead Cane (Legend)
description: What's a dapper gentleman to do when he's feeling provoked? Whack 'em with his snazzy cane!

name: White Mage's Sceptre
description: The Magi that serve the Lords of Order must be of the purest heart and hence known as a White Mage.

name: WhiteTiger's Khakkhara
description: You possess a rare power - the ability to summon and control a White Tiger Shikigami! It will serve you loyaly as long as your intent is honorable and your heart pure.

name: Wilted 4-Leaf Clover Staff
description: There's lucky, there's unlucky and then there's undead-ky. You're the third. (Only available during Friday the 13th / Lucky Day crossover events)

name: Wind Key Staff
description: Forged from a key, this staff harnesses the power of the wind to subdue your opponent.

name: Winged Amethyst Staff
description: Amethysts are known for their calming nature. This staff brings a sense of hope and peace to Yokai.

name: Winged Aurora Staff
description: Forged by a powerful image who infused the staff with the light so bright it would glow even in the darkness of times.

name: Winged Jewel of the Dragon
description: Boasting enchanted wings and a large violet jewel at the top, this Staff serves as a powerful focus for magi. This staff is particularly useful in channeling the energies of the Void.

name: Winged Sapphire Staff
description: Fashioned from beautiful sapphires this staff is beneficial for healing.

name: Wings of Ice
description: According to myth, when the iced wings of the winter faerie sweeps over the world, all falls asleep beneath the crystalline blanket of cold. Such power has been harnessed and trapped within this staff. Use it wisely, for the faerie world can be treacherous, even to the bearer.

name: Winner's Bouquet Cane
description: Walk the red carpet in this stylish frock while rocking to the Zardile Rock!

name: Winner's Bouquet Staff
description: Walk the red carpet in this stylish frock while rocking to the Zardile Rock!

name: Winter Solstice Staff
description: A delicate and etheral staff that disappears when Winter ends. At the cost of its master's life, it can blanket an entire country in snow, and put them in a deep sleep. Only a most dire circumstace would call for that fatal spell.

name: Wisteria Lore Scroll
description: This scroll dropped off a Wisteria. Take it to Loremaster Maya in the Librarium and she'll tell you more about the monster.

name: Witch's Broomstick
description: Witches use it to fly. Others use it to clean. You… you use it to pummel your enemies!

name: Wizard's Blessing
description: A staff containing highly concentrated mana, for those long trips or battles. What more could a wizard ask for?

name: Wizard's Hydra Staff
description: A staff made from the legendary Hydra and further empowered by powerful wizards.

name: Wizard's Staff
description: Murry the great wizard has crafted you one of his staves.

name: WolfBlade Surfboard (AC)
description: Blast through the waves to rep for House WolfBlade!

name: WolfBlade Surfboard (Non-AC)
description: Blast through the waves to rep for House WolfBlade!

name: Wooden Cane

name: Woven Knot Staff
description: Rock on!

name: Wrapped Pearl of Light Staff (AC)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers sow dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: Wrapped Pearl of Light Staff (Legend)
description: Nulgath not only holds dominion over the land, but also the sea. These TideWalkers sow dissent in order to promote Nulgath's Nation.

name: Wrath of Lobthulu

name: Wrath of Sciurus
description: Crafted with … oh, you said SQUIRE?

name: Wrathful Lich's Staff
description: The Wrathful Lich was once one of the most powerful magic-wielders in the Celestial Realm. before they were corrupted by darkness. The dark power they've embraced pits them against many of those who were once their allies.

name: Wyrmscale Beach Umbrella
description: Stay shady under the wings of a wyrm. This scaled parasol was fashioned from a dragon's hide to protect heroes from both sun and sea.

name: Xang Surfboard
description: Everybody loves a bad girl, who is good in an alternate reality.

name: Xeven Surfboard 2016
description: Surf's up for Xeven!

name: Xing Surfboard
description: The little devil under on your shoulder is now under your arm.

description: This innocent-looking staff conceals a deadly surprise! There is a blade inside, to help you sneak past guards (and laws against carrying weaponry.)

name: Yaksha Shrine Staff
description: Staff of the of the Yaksha Shrine Protector, any tresspassers are met with a swift fate.

name: Yokai Umbrella
description: A very strange umbrella that does more than ward off rain… it will also ward off your enemies!

name: YokiBo

description: This scroll dropped off a Zardman Boss. Take it to Loremaster Maya in the Librarium and she'll tell you more about the Zardmen.

name: Ziri Surfboard 2016

description: It was a shame to let all of those Carnaval zombies go to waste, so we made some weapons out of 'em!

name: Zurvana's Blessing
description: The gears of time have been set in motion. What will the future bring for you? (This item was originally released in DragonFable and has been imported to AQWorlds to celebrate Artix Entertainment's 20th anniversary!)
